items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: So I told Jimmy Forrest and J.D. King, "Tell Andy I ain't gonna make this trip."

ctx.x: Andy's manager, where was the band hitting; so he told me we were coming back to New York. Well, the night that we closed in Baltimore, he gave me a list of one-nighters, and New York was nowhere on it! I said, "Oh boy, here I am again, and we're going back down there." I said, "I can't make it down there," because I always did...I never did like prejudice. And down there, they were prejudiced, you know what I mean. So I said, "Well, shit, this is where I get off this time." So I told Jimmy Forrest and J.D. King,…

So I went out and joined Georgie's band. I went and played a couple of tunes with him, then he asked me did I want to join the band, and so I said, "Yeah, sure. Why not?" So he told me that they were going right to the Howard Theatre, which was right about forty miles from Baltimore. So I went over there and got me a pad, and went on it... So I was at the theatre the next day, and he called me, he told me, "You've got to run the show, man." I said, "What?" I couldn't figure that out. I said, "Well, wait, what's…
